seoTitle: How to Earn $200 With Hostinger's Referral Program
metaDescription: Learn how to earn up to $200 through the Hostinger Referral Program, from finding your link inside the dashboard to understanding the commission structure.
intro: Hostinger runs its referral program right inside the account dashboard, which means anyone who already hosts a site with them can start earning without installing anything or applying to a separate affiliate network. The program pays out a share of whatever plan the person you refer buys, and because Hostinger sells everything from shared hosting to VPS and business email, the potential commission per referral adds up fast. This guide shows exactly where the referral tool lives in the dashboard, how the reward actually gets triggered, and how much each plan pays so you know what to expect before you start sharing links.

steps.heading: Find the referral button in your dashboard
steps.body: Once you're logged into your Hostinger account, look at the top navigation bar next to the search box — there's a gift-icon button labeled "Refer & earn up to 200 USD." It's visible from every page of the dashboard, including Home, Websites, Domains, and Horizons, so you never have to dig through settings menus to find it. Clicking it opens the referral hub where your unique link and sharing options live.

image.caption: The Hostinger dashboard with the "Refer & earn up to 200 USD" button sitting in the top bar, next to the account search.

steps.heading: Understand how the referral actually pays out
steps.body: The referral hub lays out the process in four plain steps: you send an invite, they make a purchase, they stay active for at least 45 days, and only then do you get your commission. That 45-day active window matters — it means a friend who signs up and cancels within a month and a half won't generate a payout, so referring people who genuinely intend to use hosting matters more than volume. Rewards apply across hosting, VPS, and email plans of 12 months or longer, and Hostinger sends earnings out via PayPal or wire transfer rather than site credit.

image.caption: The "How do referrals work?" panel, showing the four-step path from invite to payout and the 45-day activity requirement.

steps.heading: Check the commission table for each plan
steps.body: Scrolling further into the referral hub shows a side-by-side table of Hostinger's hosting tiers, each with the price the referred customer pays and the commission you earn from it. Higher-tier plans with more websites, storage, and monthly visits pay out a larger flat commission, so pointing a referral toward a plan that actually matches their traffic needs — rather than the cheapest option — increases what you earn per sign-up. Each plan row also has a copy-link button and a "Refer via email" button, so you can send the exact plan you think fits the person you're inviting instead of a generic homepage link.

image.caption: The commission breakdown table, listing each hosting plan's price alongside the referral commission it pays out.

steps.heading: Share your link where it will actually convert
steps.body: A referral link buried in a single old tweet won't do much — the sign-ups come from being specific about why someone should switch hosts. If you run a blog or YouTube channel, a short honest mention in content about building a website converts better than a bare link in a bio, because it gives context for why you're recommending Hostinger. Friends or coworkers who've mentioned needing a website or wanting to move off a slower host are also worth a direct, personal message with your link rather than a mass post.

steps.heading: Track sign-ups and stay within the terms
steps.body: The referral hub doubles as your tracking dashboard, showing which invites converted and where each one sits in the 45-day activity window before it counts toward a payout. It's worth reading the linked Terms of Service once, since referral programs commonly restrict things like referring yourself with a second account or running paid ads directly on the word "Hostinger" — violating those terms can get commissions clawed back or the account suspended. Checking in periodically also lets you see which plans your referrals are actually choosing, so you can adjust which plan you recommend to future referrals.

faq.question: How much can I earn per referral with Hostinger?
faq.answer: It depends on the plan the referred customer buys — the referral hub shows a commission table where higher-tier hosting, VPS, and email plans pay a larger flat amount per sign-up.

faq.question: Who can join the Hostinger referral program?
faq.answer: Any existing Hostinger account holder — the referral tool is built into the dashboard, so bloggers, content creators, or anyone with a network of people who might need hosting can start immediately.

faq.question: Where do I find my referral link?
faq.answer: Click the "Refer & earn" button in the top navigation bar of your Hostinger dashboard, then copy the link for the plan you want to recommend or use the "Refer via email" option.

faq.question: Is $200 a guaranteed amount?
faq.answer: No. It reflects the higher end of what's possible depending on which plans your referrals purchase, not a guaranteed payout for signing up.

faq.question: When does a referral commission actually get paid?
faq.answer: Only after the referred customer makes a purchase and stays active on that plan for at least 45 days — cancellations within that window don't generate a payout.
